observation: Planner separates three requirement labels but rewrites Azure itself into Azure and other cloud services financial group. Reviewer then checks altered requirement and marks complete.
source_of_judgment: Direct comparison of original question, frozen C7, persisted plan descriptions, actual delivered original blocks and reviewer requirement assessments.
not_claimed: No inference of internal chain-of-thought; no claim this is the sole cause of every failure.

plan_requirements.description: Microsoft Cloud: the 10-K's definition of what it includes, and the FY2025 Microsoft Cloud revenue and growth rate as disclosed, with period, unit and qualifiers.

Intelligent Cloud segment: the 10-K's definition of the segment (principal products, services and activities, including Azure and other cloud services, server products, Enterprise and partner services), and the FY2025 segment revenue, growth and any segment operating income disclosed, with period and unit.

Azure: the 10-K's definition of Azure and other cloud services (what the line item comprises), and the FY2025 disclosed growth rate or revenue metrics for Azure. Record whether the 10-K discloses a standalone Azure revenue amount; do not estimate one.

review_requirements.rationale: The bundle has the original metric definition and the FY2025 revenue ($168.9 billion) and growth (23%).

citations.quote: Revenue from Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, Azure and other cloud services, the commercial portion of LinkedIn, and Dynamics 365
Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 23% to $168.9 billion.

review_requirements.rationale: The bundle has the segment definition and its full enumeration (server products and cloud services, plus enterprise and partner services). It also has FY2025 segment revenue of $106,265m (+21%) and operating income of $44,589m (+18%), with the unit stated.

citations.quote: Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services

review_requirements.rationale: The bundle defines Azure and other cloud services within the segment and gives the disclosed 34% growth. No standalone Azure revenue amount appears in the delivered text, so none should be inferred. The delivered blocks cannot by themselves prove absence from the whole filing; the answer should say 'not disclosed in the delivered evidence'.

citations.quote: Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services
Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 34% driven by demand for our portfolio of services.

plan_requirements.description: Microsoft FY2025 10-K: original definition of the Microsoft Cloud revenue metric (which offerings it includes) and the disclosed FY2025 Microsoft Cloud revenue amount and growth rate, with the FY2025 vs FY2024 period context and units.

Microsoft FY2025 10-K: definition of the Intelligent Cloud reporting segment (principal products, services and activities in its enumeration) and its FY2025 segment revenue and operating income amounts and growth rates, with units.

Microsoft FY2025 10-K: definition of Azure and other cloud services (its composition within Intelligent Cloud server products and cloud services) and the disclosed FY2025 growth rate for Azure and other cloud services; check whether a standalone Azure revenue amount is disclosed, without estimating one.

review_requirements.rationale: The delivered text gives the original metric definition, the FY2025 amount ($168.9B), the growth rate (23%) and the FY2025 vs FY2024 period context.

citations.quote: Revenue from Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, Azure and other cloud services, the commercial portion of LinkedIn, and Dynamics 365

review_requirements.rationale: The delivered text gives the segment definition with both enumerated components (server products and cloud services; enterprise and partner services) and the FY2025 revenue and operating income amounts and growth rates.

review_requirements.rationale: The delivered text gives Azure and other cloud services' composition within Intelligent Cloud and its 34% growth. No standalone Azure revenue amount appears in the delivered text, and none is estimated.
